The '''Battle of the Silent Blades''' was the end of a anti-piracy campaign fought by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It marked the end of the [[Tarnished Blades|Silent Blades]] and was also the spark to ignite the [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutiny]] onboard the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="FOP" />

==Prelude==
For weeks the Silent Blades had harassed the local governments and destroyed a number of [[Patrol ship/Legends|System patrol craft]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The officials were demanding [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assistance. Possessing insight on [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] tactics, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] quickly hunted the pirates down and trapped them in their [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] lair.<ref name="FOP" />

==The Battle==
After being trapped the pirates could not escape, however the terrain was too dangerous for the ''Far Orbit'' to attack alone. First Officer [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij|Dhas Vedij]] suggested to call for reinforcements, but Kenit was furious that someone else might get the glory.<ref name="FOP" />
Ignoring the advice, Kenit ordered all [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to launch and attack. The pirates fought furiously and in the end, all TIEs were destroyed. One of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] killed was [[Elon Vedij]], brother of the First Officer.<ref name="FOP" /> Despite the Imperial losses, the pirates were defeated. A few of them however, managed to escape and reformed as the [[Tarnished Blades]].<ref name="FOP" />

==Aftermath==
Saddened by the loss of his brother and furious about Kenit's ignorance and incompetence, this event brought [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij|Dhas Vedij's]] thoughts of mutiny to a final decision. A short time later, he would [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|take over]] the ship and join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="FOP" /> The few survivors of the Silent Blades would organize themselves as the [[Tarnished Blades]] under the command of [[Shel Marcino]]. With the [[HT-2200 medium freighter|light freighter]] [[Dark Vendetta (freighter)|''Dark Vendetta'']] and two [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] in their possession, they would seek revenge against the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="FOP" />
